title: Party relationship
description: A party's relationship with the bank itself. Deliberately not a general party-to-party graph: that is a different object with different owners, and conflating the two is how relationship data becomes unauditable.

partyReferenceId.description: The bank's own reference for this relationship. Distinct from partyId: the party is the customer, the reference is our account of them.

partyId.description: The party this relationship attaches to.

lineOfBusiness.description: Required for CUSTOMER by SEM-PTR-001; not enforced here because a CONNECTED_PARTY may legitimately have none.
